note: A15.7 baseline 2026-09-17: NONE. Keyed on QUEUE_* + QUEUE_FLOWS for every messaging cell in A15.7, including the eventbus-first mechanisms, because that is the graph A2.6 (cloud brokers) and A2.9 (MQTT / Redis pub/sub / NATS leave eventbus.rs) are building: an EVENT_* key would read `none` the moment those fixes land. `via` still records the eventbus path when it is the one that fired.
